warning.titlePre: Jaguar F-Type R575 Timing Chain Tensioner Design Flaw
paragraphs: If your F-Type R575 is a 2012-2014 model with the AJ133 supercharged V8, the timing chain tensioner and guide design has a documented weakness - a hardened steel tensioner piston wears an aluminium guide button over time, which can fail without warning. This exact engine was subject to a US class-action lawsuit covering multiple JLR models, including the F-Type. We replace timing chains, tensioners, guides and the water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.

The F-Type R575 was introduced later in the F-Type's lifecycle (2021-2024) as an extremely limited-run variant, and these later cars use a revision of the AJ133 that addressed some earlier concerns. However, if your R575 is from the earliest part of the production run, the pattern applies - we'll confirm your specific build year by registration before quoting.
warning.source: Source: verified via rrsport.co.uk lawsuit reference, per VRF-jaguar-f-type.md and G-BRF-Jaguar.md. Later production years outside the lawsuit scope flagged for registration verification.
